title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER (B2B + D2C)**

**Location: Hyderabad (On-site)**

**Experience: 4–7 years**

**CTC: ₹7.00 LPA – ₹9.00 LPA**

**Type: Full-time (Hiring Immediately)**

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**

Group Welkin is a corporate and bulk-order solutions group with over 50 years of

experience rooted in the Indian kitchenware and household products industry.

Alongside our B2B corporate gifting vertical, the group operates a direct-to-consumer

retail business across our house brands and produces content-led ventures including a

podcast and a mentorship programme. We are building structured digital systems

across all of these to drive consistent visibility, inbound interest, and lead generation.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

This is a full-time, on-site Digital Marketing Manager role in Hyderabad.

This is the role that takes our digital function from foundations to an operating engine.

Over the past few months, we have built a design system, rebuilt our website, and

grown our LinkedIn presence from 50 followers to over 1,000. What we need now is a

marketer who can plan the calendar, run the campaigns (Both on Meta and LinkedIn),

and lead the people doing the work.

The role spans four businesses that market in genuinely different ways: B2B corporate

gifting on LinkedIn and Meta, a D2C sweets and gifting brand (Ziya) launching into e-

commerce, a podcast that needs audience growth on YouTube and Instagram, and a

mentorship programme that markets to parents and children (Profound Ripples).

The ideal candidate has run campaigns end to end on both B2B and consumer sides on

LinkedIn and Meta, uses AI tools as part of a real workflow rather than as a novelty, and

is comfortable being asked to explain why a number moved.

**WORK LOCATION : Hyderabad**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Build and own the quarterly digital marketing plan across brands, with channel

priorities, budgets, and target numbers

• Generate qualified lead data to forward to Business Development Managers

• Bring a documented case for each proposed activity, covering cost, expected

return, and how success will be measured

• Plan, set up, and optimise paid campaigns on LinkedIn Campaign Manager

targeting B2B decision-makers, including Lead Gen Forms and Document Ads

• Plan and run consumer performance campaigns on Meta, Google, and YouTube

for our D2C brands, including festive and seasonal pushes

• Own search visibility across our platforms, covering on-page SEO, technical

health.

• Apply AEO and GEO principles so our content is surfaced in AI-generated

answers on Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini

• Own the content calendar across LinkedIn, Meta, and YouTube, and hold

published output to our brand voice standards

• Brief the design and video team on creatives, and extract subject-matter content

from our sales team for publication

• Set the measurement framework and deliver a structured weekly report covering

campaign performance, organic metrics, spend against plan, and key

observations

**QUALIFICATIONS**

• 4 to 7 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, with at least one year

guiding or reviewing another marketer's work

• Demonstrated experience across both B2B lead generation and consumer or e-

commerce marketing. This role requires both, and most candidates have only

one

• Hands-on campaign experience in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. LinkedIn

Campaign Manager experience is a must

• Working command of Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and

campaign reporting

• Solid SEO experience covering keyword research, on-page optimisation, and

technical fundamentals• Working knowledge of AEO and GEO, how AI platforms surface answers, and

how content is structured to appear in them

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, Mass Communication, or a related discipline

Preferred

**SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS**

• Comfortable doing SEO activities on a hard-coded website as well as on

WordPress and WooCommerce

• Actively uses AI tools as part of content and campaign workflow, with judgement

about where they help and where they do not

• Comfortable with social media scheduling tools (Buffer, Later, or similar)

• Strong written English for B2B communication. You will be writing plans, briefs,

and reports that go to leadership

• Able to read campaign and analytics data, form a view from it, and refine the

campaign if required

• Able to manage and develop a junior marketer, including giving direct feedback

• Organised and self-driven, able to hold a content and reporting schedule without

follow-up

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment

• E-commerce platform experience (WooCommerce or Shopify), product feeds,

and shopping campaigns are an advantage

• YouTube channel growth experience is an advantage

• Food, FMCG, gifting, or education category experience is an advantage

• Office presence is mandatory

**COMPENSATION**

CTC: ₹7.00 LPA – ₹9.00 LPA (based on experience and demonstrated skills).

We will issue the offer letter and annexure after the office visit and discussion with

management at the head office in Gandimaisamma.

**LANGUAGES**

English, Hindi. Telugu (Preferred)WHY JOIN GROUP WELKIN?

• Work with a 50-year-old trusted brand actively building its digital presence from

the ground up, with real ownership, not support work

• Lead the digital function rather than execute someone else's plan; you will set

the calendar and defend the budget

• Rare breadth in a single role: B2B lead generation, D2C e-commerce, podcast

audience growth, and mentorship marketing

• Work across SEO, AEO, GEO, paid campaigns, organic content, and team

leadership without being boxed into one channel

• Direct collaboration with leadership and a short path from decision to execution

• Ownership from day one, with scope to build the team as the function grows

• Product-based business with high repeat order potential and a well-defined B2B

audience

title: Marketing AI Specialist, Associate(Looking for Marketing background with Agentic AI experience)
description:
**Department:**
Marketing
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Description**
The Marketing Agentic Content Engineer will build and continuously improve the AI-powered agents and workflows that move content from generation through review, translation, and publishing — connecting tools such as Claude, Canva, ContentHub, Sitecore, ClickUp, and similar systems. This role owns both ends of that pipeline: the technical integrations that move content through the system, and the prompt engineering and quality practices that shape what the AI actually produces, including the brand, messaging, legal, and compliance guardrails required across Infor's specialized industry verticals (e.g., Food & Beverage, Manufacturing & Distribution). This role will partner closely with marketing content owners, creative teams, marketing operations, and process owners to ensure what gets built holds up in real production use and reflects brand and messaging guidelines, positioning, workflow requirements, approved images, and other stakeholder requirements.
  
  
This role is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building automated or agentic workflows with LLM platforms, who also know how to improve what those platforms produce — not just move it through a pipeline faster. Candidates should be able to take process direction from a review team and turn it into a working technical solution, connect their build work to broader process and strategic goals, and treat output quality as a core part of the job rather than a downstream concern. This is an individual contributor role focused on hands-on build, workflow design, and AI output quality.
  
  
**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**

* Build and maintain agentic workflows moving content from AI generation into staging and publishing systems.
* Build and maintain prompt libraries and testing practices that improve AI output quality, reduce hallucinations, and strengthen brand-voice consistency.
* Define and apply content governance guardrails — brand, messaging, legal, and compliance — particularly for Infor's specialized industry verticals, in partnership with solution marketers.
* Partner with the content process review team to translate process findings and recommendations into working agentic workflows.
* Maintain and improve integrations between systems such as Claude, Canva, ContentHub, Sitecore, ClickUp, or other similar tools.
* Set up and manage translation workflows so content can be routed and published across markets.
* Troubleshoot breakdowns in the content pipeline and fix root causes, not just symptoms — whether the issue is a broken integration or a weak prompt.
* Work with marketing content owners to understand content needs and build workflows that match real team workflows.
* Document workflows so marketing operations can run and troubleshoot them without engineering support.
* Flag scaling risks or technical debt before they block the broader content program.
* Support the ongoing build-out of the AI content program as it scales across additional teams and use cases.
* Identify where a workflow or process fix could apply beyond its original use case, and raise it as a broader opportunity to the content process review team or program leadership.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* 2-3 years building automated or agentic workflows using Claude or comparable LLM platforms, including API/tool use, not just chat-based prompting.
* Hands-on prompt engineering experience: building and testing prompts, measuring content quality, and reducing errors such as hallucinations or tone drift.
* Marketing content experience: understands content types, review/approval steps, and translation/localization needs.
* Experience integrating systems via API (webhooks, REST, or similar).
* Working experience with Canva's API or Canva-based content generation workflows.
* Experience translating process requirements or recommendations from a business or operations team into a technical build.
* Strong written communication skills, able to explain technical workflows to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and design for change in an evolving program.
* Ability to see beyond a single project and connect build work to wider team or organizational initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with ContentHub, Sitecore, Claude and/or ClickUp specifically.
* Experience setting up or managing translation/localization pipelines.
* Experience working alongside a process improvement, business analysis, or process review team.
* Familiarity with content governance or AI guardrail frameworks in a regulated or specialized industry context.

title: Head-Marketing & Brand Communication
description:
**ABOUT UPGRAD FUTURE SCHOOLS CONSORTIUM**

UpGrad Future Schools Consortium (UFSC) is the K-12 school-building arm of UpGrad, India's largest online higher-education platform. UFSC is building 45 schools over five years, structured across three phases: Phase 1 covers the first 10 schools; Phase 2 scales the network to 30 schools; and Phase 3 takes the Consortium to its full scale of 45 schools. UFSC operates across four school formats: Boutique Greenfield, Tier 1 Greenfield, Micro Schools, and Roll-Up.

UpGrad is a well-recognised name in online higher education and skilling. In the K-12 school space, UFSC is starting from zero. There is no brand awareness, no parent community, and no track record to point to. The Head of Marketing and Brand is the person who changes that — building the UFSC story in the school market from scratch, and converting that story into the leads that fill every seat in every school we open.

**THE ROLE**

This is a brand launch role, not a brand management role. The distinction matters. UFSC is entering a market where established school brands have decades of reputation, word-of-mouth networks, and parent community loyalty. The challenge is not to maintain an existing position — it is to create one, quickly, in four cities simultaneously, for a school group that most parents have never heard of.

The Head of Marketing and Brand must be equally strong at three things that most marketing professionals excel at only one of: brand building, performance marketing, and new-age digital execution powered by data and AI. The brand work creates the story that makes UFSC credible and desirable to premium and HNI families. The performance marketing work turns that credibility into a measurable pipeline of inquiries. And the new-age marketing layer — AI-driven content creation, automated lead nurturing, predictive analytics, CRM intelligence, and process efficiency — is what makes UFSC able to compete with established school brands that have decades of word-of-mouth behind them. This is not optional sophistication. It is how UFSC builds market presence at speed and at the cost efficiency a Phase 1 organisation requires.

This person owns every touchpoint through which a prospective family encounters UFSC, from a sponsored Instagram post to a school open day to a PR feature in a city lifestyle magazine. They will build the marketing function from the ground up, manage all agency relationships, and lead the Design Associate who joins alongside them. In a startup environment, they will also be doing significant execution work themselves.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Brand Strategy and Positioning**

* Build the UFSC brand narrative for the K-12 school market from scratch: the positioning, the tone of voice, the visual language, and the story that differentiates UFSC from established premium school brands in each Phase 1 city.
* Develop a clear understanding of the premium and HNI family segment in each Phase 1 city, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, including how they make school decisions, what signals quality to them, and what UFSC needs to stand for to earn their consideration.
* Work closely with the Managing Director to ensure the brand narrative is aligned with UFSC's academic philosophy, school format positioning, and the UpGrad Group's broader brand equity in education.
* Leverage UpGrad's existing brand recognition in higher education as a credibility signal in the school market, while building a distinct UFSC identity that stands on its own in the K-12 context.
* Build the UFSC brand guidelines, the complete reference framework for how the brand looks, sounds, and behaves across every channel and format, and ensure all agencies and internal stakeholders work within it.

**2. New-Age Digital Marketing, AI, and Lead Generation**

* Own UFSC's full digital marketing presence: website, SEO and SEM, social media (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube), performance marketing campaigns, and AI-powered email and WhatsApp nurture journeys targeted at prospective school families.
* Build and manage the digital marketing funnel that connects brand awareness to inquiry generation, ensuring every rupee of marketing spend is tracked against lead volume, inquiry quality, and cost per inquiry by school and city.
* Design and execute targeted digital campaigns for HNI and premium family segments across each Phase 1 city, using a mix of organic content, paid social, search, and programmatic channels tailored to where these families actually consume content.
* Own the UFSC website as a conversion tool, not just a brand asset. Every page should be designed to move a prospective parent closer to booking a school visit.
* Brief, manage, and hold accountable the outsourced digital marketing agency, setting clear KPIs for lead volume, cost per lead, and channel performance, and reviewing performance weekly.
* Embed AI tools across the marketing function: use generative AI for content creation and campaign ideation, AI-driven analytics platforms for campaign optimisation, predictive lead scoring to prioritise the highest-intent inquiries for the admissions team, and automation tools to build scalable nurture journeys without scaling headcount.
* Build a marketing analytics stack that gives real-time visibility into the full funnel, from first brand impression through inquiry, school visit booking, and conversion to enrolment, using tools such as GA4, Meta Pixel, CRM dashboards, and attribution modelling.
* Use data and AI to continuously improve marketing efficiency: A/B test creative and copy, optimise bidding strategies, identify the highest-performing inquiry sources by school and city, and reduce cost per qualified inquiry over time.
* Stay ahead of the curve on new-age marketing channels and tools relevant to the HNI and premium family segment, including WhatsApp Business API, YouTube Shorts, influencer partnerships with credible education voices, and community-led growth strategies.

**3. PR, Events, and Community**

* Build UFSC's public relations strategy and manage the PR agency relationship, generating editorial coverage in premium city lifestyle media, parenting publications, and education press that builds awareness and credibility among the target family segment.
* Design and own the school open day and parent information evening experience for each Phase 1 school, treating these as high-stakes conversion events where brand experience and admissions pipeline are built simultaneously.
* Build UFSC's presence in the premium community networks where HNI families spend time: residential associations, club networks, corporate family programmes, and curated parent communities in each Phase 1 city.
* Own UFSC's presence at relevant education fairs, expat community events, and premium lifestyle events across Phase 1 cities, ensuring the brand shows up in the right rooms.

**4. Agency and Team Management**

* Own all marketing agency relationships: digital, creative, PR, and events. Brief them precisely, manage them actively, and hold them accountable to outcomes, not activity.
* Lead the Design Associate, setting their creative brief, reviewing their output, and ensuring all in-house creative work meets the brand standard.
* Manage the marketing budget across all channels and agencies, optimising spend allocation based on channel performance and enrolment season priorities.
* Work closely with the Admissions Head to ensure marketing activity is timed and targeted to support the admissions calendar, with lead generation ramping up ahead of key inquiry and open day windows in each city.

**WHO YOU ARE**

We are looking for a marketer who has launched brands, not just managed them, and who understands how to reach and influence premium and HNI consumers specifically. The following is a guide, not a checklist.

* Eight to twelve years of experience in brand building, marketing, or growth, with a demonstrable track record of launching or repositioning a premium brand to a high-net-worth or premium consumer audience.
* You are equally strong at brand strategy and performance marketing. You can write a brand positioning document and you can read a Google Ads dashboard. You do not outsource your thinking to agencies on either side.
* You have experience in premium consumer marketing, luxury, hospitality, premium financial services, premium edtech, or a comparable category where the buyer is affluent, discerning, and makes high-involvement decisions. K-12 school marketing experience is an advantage but not essential if the consumer marketing track record is strong.
* You understand digital marketing at a level of genuine technical competence. You know how Meta campaigns are structured, what a good CPL looks like, how to brief an SEO strategy, and how to evaluate whether an agency is performing or managing optics.
* You are fluent in AI-powered marketing tools and actively use them. You use generative AI for content and creative ideation, AI analytics for campaign optimisation, and automation platforms for lead nurturing at scale. This is not a future aspiration for you — it is how you work today.
* You think in funnels and data. You can read an attribution report, identify where leads are dropping off, and make a confident decision about where to shift budget or change creative. You are as comfortable in a data dashboard as in a creative review.
* You have managed multiple agencies simultaneously and you are not intimidated by the work. You set clear briefs, you hold people to timelines and outcomes, and you are not afraid to make a change when an agency is not delivering.
* You are a strong creative thinker and you have taste. UFSC is a premium brand entering a market with established premium players. Everything we produce has to be excellent, not just adequate. You are someone who notices when something is not good enough and you know what to do about it.
* You are comfortable in a startup environment where you will be doing significant execution work yourself. You will not have a large team. You will be writing copy, reviewing designs, briefing agencies, attending open days, and building Instagram content strategies all in the same week.
* You are genuinely curious about education and you can speak with credibility and warmth to premium school parents. You understand that selling a school is a very different conversation from selling most products, and you approach it with the appropriate intelligence and sensitivity.

**Skills and Knowledge**

**Technical and Functional Skills**

* Brand strategy and positioning: ability to build a brand from scratch, define its positioning, tone of voice, and visual identity, and ensure it is consistently expressed across every channel and touchpoint.
* Performance marketing and AI-driven execution: working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, SEO and SEM strategy, programmatic display, and email and WhatsApp marketing platforms. Proficient in using AI tools for campaign optimisation, predictive lead scoring, and automated nurture sequences. Able to set KPIs, read campaign data, and optimise spend allocation in real time.
* Content strategy: ability to define and oversee a content strategy across social, web, email, and offline channels that builds brand awareness and drives inquiry generation with a premium family audience.
* PR and media relations: experience managing PR agencies and building media relationships that generate editorial coverage in the right publications for a premium consumer brand.
* Events and experiential marketing: experience designing and executing brand events, open days, and community engagement activations that convert attendees into leads.
* Marketing analytics and attribution: ability to build and manage a marketing analytics stack covering GA4, Meta Pixel, CRM dashboards, and multi-touch attribution modelling. Can identify the highest-performing lead sources, track funnel conversion at every stage, and use insights to drive continuous improvement in marketing ROI.
* Budget management: able to manage a marketing budget across multiple channels and agencies, track spend against results, and optimise allocation based on ROI.

**Leadership and Behavioural Skills**

* Creative leadership: strong aesthetic sensibility and the ability to brief, evaluate, and push creative work to a standard appropriate for a premium school brand.
* Data orientation: uses data to make marketing decisions. Tracks the funnel from impression to inquiry to school visit and knows which levers to pull when numbers are off target.
* Agency management: clear, demanding, and fair in managing agencies. Sets precise briefs, reviews outputs rigorously, and is not satisfied with activity reports as a substitute for results.
* Startup mindset: comfortable doing significant execution work personally in Phase 1. Does not wait for a full team to be in place before making progress.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of how premium and HNI families in Indian Tier 1 cities make school decisions, including the role of word-of-mouth, school visits, social proof, curriculum brand, and peer networks in the decision process.
* Familiarity with the premium K-12 school landscape in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, including how established school brands are positioned and what UFSC needs to do to earn consideration alongside them.
* Understanding of the marketing channels and community networks where premium and HNI families in India are most reachable and most likely to engage with school-related content.

**Qualification**

* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Brand Management, or Business Administration from a reputed institution is preferred.
* Candidates with an outstanding brand launch track record in a relevant premium consumer category will be considered regardless of formal qualification.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 12 MONTHS**

Success is a UFSC brand that premium families in four cities know, respect, and are actively inquiring about, and a marketing engine that is generating the leads the Admissions Head needs to fill every school.

* UFSC has a complete brand identity: positioning, tone of voice, visual guidelines, and a narrative that is consistently applied across all channels and all cities.
* A digital marketing engine is live and performing, generating qualified inquiries for each Phase 1 school at an agreed cost per inquiry, with weekly reporting to the MD and Admissions Head.
* Each Phase 1 school has held at least one successful open day or parent information evening, with attendance meeting or exceeding target and a measurable conversion to admissions inquiries.
* UFSC has media presence in the key premium lifestyle and parenting publications in each Phase 1 city, with editorial coverage that builds credibility with the target family segment.
* All agency relationships are contracted, performing against agreed KPIs, and managed actively with monthly performance reviews.
* The marketing and brand infrastructure built in Phase 1 is documented, scalable, and ready to support the launch of 20 additional schools in Phase 2 without starting from scratch.

**WHAT THIS ROLE OFFERS**

* The opportunity to build a brand from zero in one of India's most competitive and most consequential consumer categories, with the backing of UpGrad and the freedom to do it properly.
* A role with genuine creative and commercial ownership, reporting directly to the Managing Director, with meaningful influence over how UFSC presents itself to India's most discerning school parents.
* The institutional credibility and financial backing of UpGrad, India's largest edtech platform, combined with the pace and ownership of building a new venture.

title: Senior Marketing Executive, Performance Marketing
description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ-EQ**
Is a global investor services group with deep expertise in private markets. We support investment managers, asset owners and global businesses with the administration, compliance, governance, data and reporting that their structures depend on.
  
  
Across 25 jurisdictions, our 6,500+ professionals combine technical strength, connected technology and human understanding – the IQ and the EQ – to free clients from operational complexity and give them the peace of mind to focus on their core business activities.
  
  
Our IQ is our technical, regulatory and operational expertise, underpinned by data, technology and coordinated global delivery. Our EQ is our human partnership: understanding the business behind the numbers, the culture behind the structures and the individuals behind the screens.
  
  
With more than US$950 billion of assets under administration, our global client base includes 13 of the world’s top 15 private equity firms\* and 19 of the top 25 private debt firms\*\*.
  
  
One relationship connects our clients to the right expertise as needs evolve, helping them move forward with clarity and confidence, wherever they operate..
  
  
To find out more about IQ-EQ visit iqeq.com
  
  
**Job Description**
**Note:**
Candidates must have hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Applications without this experience may not be considered.
  
  
The Senior Marketing Executive, Performance Marketing role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within IQ-EQ's global marketing function. Working across a diverse portfolio of digital initiatives, you'll help ensure marketing investment delivers strong business outcomes through a combination of strategic thinking, analytical rigour and effective cross-functional collaboration. This is an excellent opportunity for a marketing professional looking to deepen their expertise within a global, growth-focused organisation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* You'll support the planning, execution, and optimisation of digital advertising campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Ads, and Display platforms, ensuring alignment with campaign objectives and performance goals.
* You'll manage campaign performance by monitoring and improving key metrics such as CTR, CPC, and conversion rates through audience segmentation, keyword research, forecasting, and campaign structure optimisation.
* You'll ensure accurate end-to-end campaign tracking and data-driven decision-making using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
* You'll collaborate with design and content teams to deliver compelling ad creative and messaging that align with brand standards, marketing objectives, and target audiences.
* You'll stay up to date with digital marketing best practices, provide recommendations for continuous improvement, foster knowledge sharing within the marketing team, and offer operational support and guidance as needed.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health & Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances & Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.

**Qualifications**
**About you**

* You have hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Google Analytics, with a strong understanding of digital advertising platforms and performance measurement.
* You possess knowledge of campaign tracking fundamentals and Google Tag Manager (GTM), with the ability to support accurate campaign attribution and reporting.
* You have a strong analytical mindset, using data and insights to support optimisation decisions while demonstrating a willingness to learn and grow.
* You communicate effectively in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* You are flexible and able to work European business hours while collaborating effectively with global teams.

**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
  
  
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
  
  
Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 25 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
  
  
We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success.

title: Business Head
description:

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

Your expertise will be crucial in defining and realizing our global aspirations, driving sustainable growth, and ensuring our position as a leader in the industry.

We are looking for a dynamic professional with strong operational expertise and proven leadership

experience who can make a meaningful impact on our expanding business presence. If you are eager to contribute to the evolving world of food and technology and possess the skills to lead with excellence, we would be delighted to have you join our team.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive business strategies aligned with the company’s vision, objectives, and long-term growth plans within the F&B industry.
* Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify emerging trends, customer preferences, and new business opportunities, enabling the organization to maintain a strong competitive advantage.
* Manage end-to-end operations of the F&B business unit, ensuring seamless coordination across departments and delivering operational excellence.
* Streamline operational processes and implement efficiency-driven initiatives to enhance productivity, optimize resource utilization, and reduce operational costs.
* Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management to achieve revenue growth, profitability, and financial sustainability targets.

* Promote a positive and customer-focused workplace culture that encourage teamwork, innovation, and superior service delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Proven 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in the food services or F&B industry, with a strong track record of driving business growth, operational excellence, and profitability in high-performance environments.

* Demonstrated success in leading large-scale business operations, managing cross-functional teams, and delivering strategic initiatives in a senior leadership capacity.

* Sound financial expertise with proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management, cost optimization, and revenue enhancement strategies.
* Deep understanding of the food services industry, market trends, customer behavior, operational best practices, and competitive business landscapes.

**Message from CEO:**

We've come to realize that we're not merely in the B2B Food service industry; we're in the business of 'Capturing Hearts.' We find ourselves in a unique position to turn ordinary, mundane corporate cafeterias into places of pure delight, where individuals can freely express themselves, find inspiration, and share happiness. Such a profound transformation opportunity is a rare gift, where the purpose of our enterprise transcends the ordinary. If this vision resonates with you, we invite you to join us in our mission to spread joy and happiness in a world weighed down by stress and pressure. Together, let's play our part in making this world a more beautiful place.

title: Enablement Marketing Manager - India
description:
**We're looking for a**
****Enablement Marketing Manager - India****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Pune Office**
Enablement Marketing Manager - India
  
  
Job Description | Enablement Marketing Campaigns Manager
  
  
Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University
  
  
**About Cornerstone**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
**About The Role**
As part of the Cornerstone University team, the Enablement Marketing Campaigns Manager leads marketing and communications for Cornerstone’s customer education business. You’ll connect Marketing, Product Marketing, Product, Enablement, Customer Success, and Community teams through shared planning, clear communications, and coordinated campaigns.
  
  
You’ll help customers discover and engage with learning and community programs throughout their journey, supporting activation, retention, and growth. This is an influence-led role: success depends on building alignment and driving coordinated work across teams, not formal authority.
  
  
This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***Integrated Marketing Calendar:***

* Own an integrated marketing calendar connecting Cornerstone University programs to product releases, strategic launches, lifecycle campaigns, events, and community activity.
* Establish a planning cadence across stakeholders, creating shared visibility, accountability, and coordination.
* Identify conflicts, gaps, and dependencies early; influence decisions on prioritization, sequencing, and positioning.
* Map education and community touchpoints across onboarding, adoption, expansion, renewal, and advocacy; work with Customer Success and Cornerstone University to address gaps.

**Campaign Creation, Segmentation And Personalization**

* Support customer and learner personas that reflect audience needs, nuances, and opportunities.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and Data teams to segment learners by role, product, maturity, and account-health signals.
* Plan and coordinate personalized, telemetry-triggered campaigns and nurture journeys using a marketing automation or journey-orchestration platform.
* Know when to use AI to support development of content creation within brand guardrails; personalize campaigns at scale, with the discernment to leverage AI-driven segmentation and send-time optimization.
* Review copy for accuracy, relevance, tone, bias, and brand fit, using sound judgment before publication.

**Cornerstone U Product Marketing**

* Develop positioning and messaging for Cornerstone University and Community programs to increase activation across learning, certification, and digital experiences.
* Plan and support launches for courses, certifications, learning paths, and community programs across internal and external channels.
* Elevate the Cornerstone University brand internally through campaigns that engage employees in education and community offerings.
* Build the foundation for Cornerstone University product marketing, including learner personas, messaging frameworks, and program measurement.

**What Success Looks Like**

* With the first 90 days, develop targets and reporting definitions will be agreed with stakeholders using available baselines and data.
* Launch integrated planning motion within the first three months, including a current, shared marketing calendar connects education initiatives with product releases, launches, lifecycle programs, events, and community activity.
* Secure initial stakeholder alignment on the integrated calendar, with planning and communications following a consistent cadence, with clear ownership and fewer late-discovered conflicts or dependencies.
* Campaign-driven activation and enrollment: Campaigns contribute to increased activation and enrollment in relevant learning, certification, and community programs. Certification enrollment and completion improve against agreed targets.
* Customer progress: Learners move into higher Customer Engagement & Expertise bands, with progress tracked against an agreed baseline within the first year.
* Measured impact: Campaigns are evaluated using holdout groups where feasible, alongside A/B tests, to distinguish campaign impact from organic activity.
* Audience relevance: Segmentation, AI-supported personalization, and testing inform campaign decisions and improve the customer experience.

**Required Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, or program management.
* Hands-on experience with a marketing automation or journey-orchestration platform, such as Marketo or Gainsight Journey Orchestrator.
* Experience leading cross-functional programs with competing priorities and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience building planning systems—such as roadmaps, calendars, playbooks, or frameworks—that support a scalable operating rhythm.
* Experience coordinating product launches or release readiness.
* Practical experience using AI tools for content creation and personalization, with the judgment to discern and refine both the output and the outcome.
* Comfort with segmentation, campaign data, dashboards, and measurement approaches such as holdout groups and A/B testing.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to tailor messaging, tone, and detail to different audiences.
* Ability to work regular overlap hours with US-based teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in B2B SaaS marketing.
* Experience with customer education, academies, certifications, or training programs.
* Background in Customer Success, Enablement, or community marketing.

**AI & Continuous Learning**

* Uses AI tools in their own work and can show an example where AI changed how the work is done, not just how fast.
* Evaluates AI output critically for accuracy, bias, privacy and data handling, and knows when a human must decide.
* Actively explores internal (Cornerstone AI) and external tools, brings recommendations to the team, and retires tools and processes that do not earn their place.
* Keeps skills current through communities, certifications, hands-on experimentation and industry learning, and shares what they learn with the team.

**How You Work**

* Customer obsessed: Start with the problem, not the tool.
* Innovate and transform: Challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that do not earn their place.
* Proactive leadership: See problems and act before being asked.
* Get it done: Ship, measure and iterate.
* Forward looking: Plan for where technology and the business are going.
* AI native: Use AI daily to rethink work, not just accelerate it.
* Get uncomfortable to succeed: Take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

title: Market Insights Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.
  
  
The role functionally and administratively reports to India-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Market Insights Manager Primary Research has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Autonomously manage global primary market research (qualitative and quantitative) of all levels of complexity, incorporating diverse stakeholder perspectives to ensure organizational alignment and buy-in. Strength in applying advanced statistical analyses and leveraging business intelligence to support strategic, tactical and operational initiatives as well as planning and implementation of new and potential USP products and programs is essential.
* Steward projects to generate actionable and meaningful insights. Develop research plans to meet business needs, consult with internal business partners, establish and manage schedules, monitor progress, and compellingly communicate the results
* Acquire and manage market research vendors to ensure quality work is provided on-time, on-budget, and that it is reported with a suitable degree of professionalism
* Proactively serve as a thought partner with USP leadership. Participate in corporate planning and new product development processes to identify opportunities, address needs, and support the development of business and marketing plans
* Proactively bring external perspectives and insight into business planning for the organization, accomplished through:
* Monitor trends in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food and other related industries to assess their implications for USP business lines
* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Basic Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred. Preferred majors in market research, marketing, science, business, or related social science discipline.
* 7 or more years of experience in applying Market Research to solve broad strategic business problems.
* Strong business writing skills – evidence of succinct, distilled reports and attention to detail through thoroughness and accuracy
* Strong verbal and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to present statistical information to non-statistically oriented audiences
* Widespread knowledge of advanced primary market research methodology.
* Business acumen and strong analytical skills
* Advanced Intermediate skills with the following programs:
* MS Excel
* MS PowerPoint
* MS Word
* Online survey tools, bulletin boards and focus group platforms (Qualtrics preferred)
* Statistical software packages – R, SPSS, etc.
* Has the ability to navigate through ambiguity with courage and leadership.
* Must be self-motivated and customer-focused.
* Excellent time and project management skills, with demonstrated ability to concurrently prioritize multiple tasks with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Prior experience in global market research, pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food or related, regulated industries is highly desired.
* Experience working in a not-for-profit organization.
* Experience working in a scientific organization.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Sales & Marketing
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

title: Founding Marketer
description:
Location: Hyderabad
  
  

* Type: Full-time
* Experience: 7+
* Type: In-Person Only (Hyderabad)

**About Landseek AI**
Landseek AI is building the future of how people discover, evaluate, and buy land and other investable real estate assets. We combine AI with rich, on-the-ground data to make real estate decisions faster, smarter, and more transparent for buyers, investors, and developers.
  
  
We're an ambitious, fast-moving team of highly passionate Real Estate & AI Researchers —and we want to build products that bring the Real Estate asset class on parity with the Stock Market.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring our Founding Marketer, to help us find product-market fit.
  
  
You'll lead customer discovery, customer validation, and take part in product research, using marketing as our fastest instrument for learning. You'll run interviews on your own and alongside the founders, and test positioning, messaging, and channels through landing pages, outreach, content, ads, and community. You'll run many small, capital-efficient experiments rather than a few big bets, and turn what you learn into evidence the team can build on.
  
  
There's no hierarchy here. You'll work side by side with the founders, and your findings will directly shape what we build and who we build it for. Once we find fit, you'll be the one who turns it into a growth engine and builds the marketing team behind it.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* High Integrity: You're honest and transparent in everything you do, with customers, partners, and the team. You keep your word, own your mistakes, and share bad news early.
* High Motivation: You thrive in pre-PMF ambiguity, take ownership without being asked, and do whatever the stage demands.
* Data Influenced: You set a metric before you launch, and change the plan when the numbers say so.
* Experiment Driven: You turn opinions into tests you can run in days, and learn from every failure.
* Customer Centric: You'd rather talk to a land aggregator than sit in a brainstorm, and you bring back their exact words.
* Entrepreneurial: You think like an owner of the business, work scrappy, and care about revenue over reach.
* Iterative Approach: You ship marketing experiments fast, learn, and improve. You don't wait for perfection.
* Questions Assumptions: You ask "how do we know?", even of the founders, and then go find out.

**What You'll Do**
  
  

* Customer Discovery:

+ Map the segments (investors, developers, banks, agents, channel partners, aggregators) and how each evaluates land today.
+ Run customer interviews on your own and with the founders, and capture their exact language. Identify the segments with the sharpest pain and the clearest willingness to pay.

* Channels & Content: The instruments for experiments

+ Find which channels reach each segment: LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram, outreach, communities, events, partners, Ads and SEO.
+ Create the content each experiment needs, from posts and carousels to YouTube videos and Instagram Reels, often yourself.

* Customer Validation:

+ Turn hypotheses into fast tests: landing pages, cold outreach, waitlists, demo requests, and pilot offers.
+ Define what counts as a signal before each test (sign-ups, calls booked, payment).
+ Be part of the sales process: join early sales conversations and pilots alongside our Sales Associates and founders, and learn what closes a deal and what stalls one.
+ Kill segments and messages that don't convert, and double down on those that do.

* Positioning & Messaging:

+ Test value propositions, headlines, and offers head to head.
+ Own the positioning narrative: who we're for, what pain points we address, and what value additions we bring to the table.

* Product Research:

+ Share customer insights with Product and Engineering on a regular rhythm.
+ Help prioritize features based on what customers act on, not what they say.
+ Test new features or concepts in the market before they're built.

* Build the Growth Engine:

+ Scale the channels that work into a repeatable acquisition engine.
+ Build the brand, the marketing team, and agency partners behind it.

**What You'll Need**
Must-haves
  
  

* 7+ years in marketing, including time at an early-stage startup or taking a product, segment or channel from zero to one.
* Customer discovery experience: you've run customer interviews and turned what you heard into positioning or product decisions.
* An experimentation track record: you can walk us through tests you ran, what the results were, and what changed because of them.
* Sharp writing and storytelling across positioning, messaging, landing pages, decks and sales collateral.
* Comfort with numbers: you can read funnels and analytics, and change the plan because of them.
* Hands-on across channels (LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram, outreach, SEO) and able to create content yourself, without waiting on a designer or agency.
* Excellent communication: confident in front of customers, founders, partners and investors.

Nice-to-haves
  
  

* B2B or enterprise marketing experience, including working closely with sales teams on pipeline and deals.
* Academic background in Marketing from Tier 1 Universities
* Experience in real estate, PropTech, fintech or banking.
* Product marketing experience at a SaaS or AI company.
* Ex-founder or early employee at a startup.
* A network across real estate, banking or investor circles.
* Fluency in Telugu or Hindi.
* Comfortable on camera, for YouTube videos, Reels and founder-led content.
* Hands-on with design and editing tools (Canva, Figma, CapCut, Premiere).
* Uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut AI) to move faster.
* Experience hiring and managing a small team or agencies.

Skills: landing pages,social media marketing,youtube growth,meta business suite,claude,premiere pro,positioning,figma,ai tools,canva,real estate,short-form video creation,youtube studio,content marketing,seo,analytics tools

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  
We are looking for experienced Marketing Manger for overseeing the decision-making process for new products, including conceptualization, prioritization, and successful market launches. Ensuring the review and implementation of pre-launch strategies and brand plans, while fostering strong relationships with key customers. Deliberating with the cross-functional team regarding the profitability of new products, and making final decisions on new product ideas from a marketing perspective.

10-12
years of experience in Indian Pharmaceutical Industry and experience in Product Management, launching at least one new product.

**Behavioural Skills**

• Strong networking skills
  
  
• Effective people management abilities
  
  
• Adaptability and change management skills
  
  
• Strategic orientation and decision-making capabilities
  
  
• Creative and ability to draw insights

Global Generics India**
  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. title: Marketing Engineer
description:
Marketing Engineer – Social Media & Performance Marketing

Kitab · Full-time · On-site, Hyderabad · 3+ years · AI-native role

About Kitab

Kitab brings ancient wisdom into modern life. We turn texts like the Bhagavad Gita and the Puranas into clear, practical guidance for everyday problems: stress, relationships, purpose and decisions. Everything we build serves three pillars: Know Yourself, Grow Yourself, Free Yourself.

Kitab is backed by Sunera Group, led by founder Ravi Reddy Kaki, who has built and exited companies before. We're a new product, but not a first-time team.

Why this role exists

Our organic content shows the message resonates. Now we need one person who connects the dots: social campaigns that build a community, paid media that brings the right people into the app, and measurement that shows who stays. We call it a Marketing Engineer because we want someone who builds systems (playbooks, testing, tracking and automation), not someone who only posts or only runs ads.

Reports to: Growth Lead (Growth department)

What you'll own

• Social media campaigns on Instagram and YouTube (plus LinkedIn where it fits): themes, content calendars, launch moments and community growth

• Creator and community campaigns: creator collaborations, podcast guests, user-generated content and our WhatsApp community

• Paid media on Meta and Google: budget split, audiences, creative themes and weekly optimisation

• The organic-to-paid flywheel: spot posts that win organically and scale them with paid

• Tracking: social analytics, pixels and SDKs, Conversions API, a mobile measurement partner, Firebase, GA4 and UTMs

• Results: reach, saves, shares and follower growth; cost per install, activated users, retention and CAC

Frameworks you'll use

• Hero–Hub–Help for big moments, recurring series and everyday content

• See–Think–Do–Care to map every campaign to an intent stage

• Content pillars: Know Yourself, Grow Yourself, Free Yourself

• A metric tree: reach → engagement → clicks → installs → activated users → retained users

• Creative diagnostics: hook rate, hold rate, saves, shares, CTR and conversion

• ICE scoring and LTV:CAC to prioritise tests and spend

How AI fits this role

• Track trends, comments and conversations with AI and turn them into campaign ideas

• Draft calendars, campaign concepts and creator briefs with Claude, then sharpen them with your judgment

• Test hooks, captions and creative at speed with our video team using HeyGen and Higgsfield

• Get the best from Advantage+ and Google's automated campaigns with clean signals and creative variety

• Personalise messages by life problem, audience and market

• Automate reporting, comment insight and budget-pacing alerts

• Prompt engineering: keep a prompt library for on-brand, policy-safe captions, ads, briefs and analysis

• No fear-based hooks, fake urgency, engagement bait or claims to cure anxiety. In wellbeing, trust is the product.

What AI-native means here

You use AI every working day, not occasionally. You keep a shared prompt library (brand voice, caption and hook prompts, creator briefs, ad analysis), you can show us the prompts behind your best work, and you've automated at least one repetitive task. In the assignment, we'll ask for your prompts alongside the plan.

Must-haves

• 3+ years running social media campaigns and paid ads, accountable for growth and results

• Instagram and YouTube campaigns that grew reach, engagement and community, with numbers to show

• Hands-on Meta Ads and Google Ads, including app install or conversion campaigns

• Creator collaborations: finding, briefing and measuring creators

• Tracking: social analytics, pixels, SDKs, Conversions API, AppsFlyer, Branch or Adjust, Firebase, GA4

• Strong spreadsheet analysis: engagement, cohorts, CAC and payback

• Knowledge of Meta and Google policies for wellbeing and religious content

• Prompt engineering and daily use of AI tools

Tools you must know

• Paid ads: Meta Ads Manager and Events Manager (incl. Advantage+), Google Ads (App, Search, YouTube)

• Social: Meta Business Suite, Instagram Insights, YouTube Studio, a scheduler (Buffer, Later or Meta)

• Tracking: GA4, Firebase, Google Tag Manager, UTMs, AppsFlyer, Branch or Adjust

• Reporting: advanced Google Sheets or Excel, Looker Studio

• Creative: Canva, CapCut

• AI: Claude or ChatGPT, with your own prompt library

• Research: Meta Ad Library, Google Ads Transparency Center

• Workflow: ClickUp

Good to know: Apple Search Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, SQL/BigQuery, social listening tools, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Zapier, Make or n8n

Nice-to-haves

• Wellness, meditation, edtech, spiritual or subscription brands

• LinkedIn and WhatsApp community campaigns

• Google Ads and Meta certifications

Who you are

Experience gets you the interview. Who you are gets you the role. We look for people who are grounded, curious, accountable, kind, humble and purpose-driven, and whose everyday life reflects what Kitab stands for:

• Know Yourself: you have a way to reflect, whether journaling, meditation, prayer, long walks or quiet time

• Grow Yourself: you read books, not just feeds, and keep learning

• Free Yourself: you love social media as a creator, yet you can put your phone down

• Conscious action: you wouldn't create content or ads that mislead or harm people

• Discipline and balance: healthy rhythms of sleep, movement and routine

• Service: you give back in some way

This isn't about religion, diet, rituals or background. People of every faith and none belong at Kitab.

Your first 90 days

• Day 30: social channels, past campaigns and tracking audited and fixed; first campaign calendar agreed; first paid tests live

• Day 60: first integrated campaign (organic, creators and paid) run end to end; weekly creative testing with the social and video teams

• Day 90: we know which channels bring people who stay; quarterly social and paid plan agreed; reporting automated; playbook documented

Compensation

Competitive, based on your experience and results. We'll discuss it openly in the first conversation.

Hiring process

1. Intro conversation with the Growth Lead

2. Work walkthrough: a social campaign and an ad account you've managed (anonymised is fine)

3. 72-hour assignment: a 30-day Kitab campaign covering organic content, one creator collaboration, Meta and Google ads, tracking, KPIs and 5 hooks, with the prompts you used

4. Culture conversation with Ganesh and Kitab leadership

5. Offer

How to apply

Apply here, then email one social campaign and one paid campaign case study (with results) to socials@kitab.com with the subject "Marketing Engineer – [Your name]". Tell us one habit that keeps you grounded.

description:

NexBase

Hyderabad, India

Full-time

**About NexBase:**

NexBase is a recruitment services company focused on connecting businesses with qualified talent across multiple non-IT industries in the United States. We use technology, automation, and data-driven workflows to improve recruitment operations and business growth.

We are looking for a
**Marketing Automation Specialist**
to manage our email infrastructure, outbound campaigns, business process automations, and coordination with external freelancers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Email Infrastructure & Management**

* Set up and manage company-owned Google Workspace accounts, business email addresses, and domains.
* Configure and monitor email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Manage mailbox provisioning, permissions, aliases, and account administration.
* Monitor email deliverability, sender reputation, bounces, and spam complaints.
* Maintain an organized inventory of email accounts, domains, subscriptions, and configurations.

**2. Email Campaigns & Outreach**

* Build, launch, and manage outbound email campaigns using tools such as Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, or similar platforms.
* Create email sequences, personalization rules, follow-up workflows, and campaign schedules.
* Manage prospect lists, data validation, deduplication, and segmentation.
* Track campaign performance, including delivery rates, replies, positive responses, and qualified meetings.
* Investigate campaign performance issues and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain suppression lists, respect opt-outs, and follow applicable email marketing laws and platform policies.

**3. Business Process Automation**

* Design, build, and maintain automations using Make, n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms.
* Integrate CRM systems, databases, email platforms, and other business applications.
* Work with Airtable, Baserow, APIs, webhooks, and AI tools to automate repetitive tasks.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend practical automation solutions.
* Test workflows, troubleshoot failures, and implement error notifications and recovery procedures.
* Document workflows so they can be maintained by other team members.

**4. Freelancer & Project Coordination**

* Coordinate with freelancers for specialized automation and development projects.
* Prepare clear project briefs, technical requirements, and deliverables.
* Monitor timelines, review completed work, and test solutions before deployment.
* Manage project documentation and ensure all deliverables, credentials, and configurations remain under company control.
* Ensure freelancers receive only the access and information necessary to complete assigned work.

**5. Data Security & System Administration**

* Maintain appropriate access controls, multi-factor authentication, and secure credential-management practices.
* Protect confidential company information, client contacts, candidate data, contracts, and financial records.
* Follow least-privilege access principles when configuring integrations and assigning permissions.
* Maintain system inventories, change logs, documentation, and recovery procedures.
* Report suspicious activity, exposed credentials, or potential data incidents immediately.
* Ensure company systems remain accessible and recoverable if a freelancer or employee leaves.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 2–4 years of experience in marketing automation, email operations, marketing technology, or workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience managing email campaigns and automation platforms.
* Practical knowledge of Google Workspace administration and domain configuration.
* Understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, email deliverability, and sender reputation.
* Experience with at least one automation platform, preferably Make or n8n.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, databases, APIs, and webhooks.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to coordinate freelancers and manage multiple projects.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and organizational skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, confidentiality, and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, or comparable outbound platforms.
* Experience integrating Airtable or Baserow with other business applications.
* Familiarity with AI agents and AI-powered workflow automation.
* Basic understanding of OAuth, API-key security, access logs, and permission management.
* Experience supporting international B2B operations, preferably with US-based businesses.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will be evaluated based on:**

* Reliability and maintainability of business automations.
* Campaign quality, deliverability, positive replies, and qualified opportunities.
* Reduction in manual work through successful automation.
* Timely execution of campaigns and automation projects.
* Quality of documentation and freelancer coordination.
* Compliance with company security procedures and protection of confidential data.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to own and improve core business systems.
* Exposure to international B2B operations and AI-driven automation.
* A role with significant responsibility, independence, and opportunities for professional growth

**How to Apply**

Please submit your résumé along with a brief description of an email campaign or automation workflow you have personally implemented.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assessment covering campaign operations, automation design, troubleshooting, and data security.

**We are looking for someone who can build, operate, troubleshoot, and improve systems—not just someone familiar with the names of automation tools.**

**Job Description — Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

Y-Axis Overseas Careers · October 2026

**About Y-Axis and the opportunity**

Y-Axis is hiring one person to build and scale a new direct-to-consumer channel: service products that customers browse, choose and buy online without a sales call.

Y-Axis Overseas Careers is one of India's best-known migration and overseas career consultancies. For years our services have been sold through counsellors and branches. We are now packaging them as fixed-scope, fixed-price products, such as Work in Europe, Work in Germany and Work in Dubai for Nurses, sold through dedicated sales pages with a self-serve checkout.

Selling a service online is harder than selling a physical product. The buyer cannot touch it, the outcome is months away, and trust decides the sale. We need someone who has already solved that problem in a service business, not only in retail or FMCG e-commerce.

**The role: Growth Lead – D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

**Location**

Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

**Experience**

6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, at least 3 in a service-based business

**Reports to**

Head of Digital / Business Head

**Works with**

Performance marketing, web development, design, CRM, content, sales and operations

**Role summary**

You will own the online sale of Y-Axis service products end to end: the product catalogue, the storefront and checkout, the traffic that reaches it, and the revenue it produces. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and do much of the work yourself, while directing existing marketing, web and CRM teams to execute.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and revenue ownership**

•    Own the growth plan and revenue target for online service products, with clear goals for customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS) and payback.

•    Decide which products, countries and customer segments to prioritise, using data on demand, margin and conversion.

•    Run a weekly growth review with clear owners, actions and results.

**Catalogue and offer**

•    Turn Y-Axis services into clear, buyable products: scope, inclusions, timelines, price points, tiers and bundles.

•    Write and maintain product pages, comparison tiles and FAQs that answer objections before they become sales calls.

•    Work with finance and operations on pricing, refunds, instalments and payment options.

**Storefront, checkout and conversion**

•    Own the sales-page and checkout journey on y-axis.com, from product tiles to payment and confirmation.

•    Brief design and development on new pages and features; write clear requirements and test before launch.

•    Build trust into every step: reviews, success stories, credentials, guarantees and a transparent process.

•    Run A/B tests on headlines, pricing display, trust signals, creatives and checkout steps.

**Acquisition and retention**

•    Direct paid acquisition across Google, Meta, YouTube and affiliates for product-led campaigns.

•    Work with SEO and content teams to build organic demand for each product page.

•    Set up abandoned-cart recovery and lifecycle journeys across email, WhatsApp and SMS.

•    Design a hybrid path where high-intent buyers can move between self-serve checkout and a counsellor without friction.

•    Drive upsell and cross-sell to related services after the first purchase.

**Analytics and reporting**

•    Track the full funnel in GA4: sessions, product views, add-to-cart, checkout starts, payments and refunds.

•    Report weekly to leadership on revenue, conversion, CAC and drop-off points, with clear next actions.

**What we are looking for**

•    6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, with at least 3 in a service-based industry: edtech, immigration, study abroad, travel, healthcare, insurance, fintech or professional services.

•    Proven record of selling a service or digital product online, with numbers to show: revenue grown, conversion improved, CAC reduced.

•    Hands-on with GA4, tag management, A/B testing tools, landing-page builders and payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar).

•    Has managed paid media budgets with a clear return.

•    Understands high-consideration buying: long decision cycles, trust building and the hand-off between digital and human sales.

•    Clear, persuasive product copywriting in English; can brief developers and designers precisely.

•    Comfortable working without a dedicated team, influencing other teams to get things done.

**Good to have**

•    Experience launching a D2C or self-serve channel inside a sales-led business.

•    Knowledge of international markets (Europe, Gulf, Canada, Australia) and NRI or migrant audiences.

•    Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and WhatsApp commerce.

**How we will measure success**

**Metric**

**What it tells us**

**Online service-product revenue vs target**

Is the channel delivering?

**Visit-to-purchase conversion rate**

Is the storefront doing its job?

**CAC and ROAS**

Is growth profitable?

**Average order value and cross-sell revenue**

Are tiers, bundles and upsells landing?

**Refund and cancellation rate**

Are we selling the right product to the right buyer?

**What we offer and how to apply**

**What we offer**

•    The chance to build a new revenue channel from the ground up, with leadership backing.

•    Direct impact on people's lives: every sale helps someone start an overseas career.

•    A strong brand, an established customer base and a large existing service catalogue to package and sell.

•    Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives.

**How to apply**

* Send your CV and a short note (no more than 300 words) to [email address]. In the note, tell us about one service or digital product you helped sell online: what you changed, and what happened to the numbers.
