title: VP, Product Management - Applied Intelligence
description:
**Who We Are**
Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world's leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.
  
  
We're an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.
  
  
**Our Values**
**Customers**
We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.
  
  
**Action**
We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.
  
  
**Team Spirit**
We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.
  
  
**Innovation**
We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.
  
  
**Excellence**
We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The VP, Applied Intelligence is a Senior leadership role accountable for setting the AI vision that defines Billtrust's next chapter. You will harness AI tools, co-worker agents, and frontier intelligence capabilities to architect a product strategy that reshapes how 2,600+ global customers experience the future of B2B finance — bringing the irreplaceable human judgment required to turn transformative technology into durable competitive advantage.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and operating as a key member of the Product leadership team, you will own Billtrust's Applied Intelligence agenda end-to-end: setting the multi-year roadmap, building and inspiring a world-class organization, and serving as the company's most senior external voice on AI-powered B2B finance. This role demands more than AI expertise alone. It requires a genuine understanding of how
  
  
money moves through complex B2B relationships, and what it takes to replace manual, error-prone financial workflows with intelligent automation that customers trust with their cash. This is an executive mandate to define what an AI-first AR platform looks like, and to make it real at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
**AI Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Set Billtrust's Applied Intelligence vision and multi-year product roadmap, establishing the strategic framework that guides how AI shapes every layer of the AR lifecycle.
* Serve as a member of the Product leadership team, shaping company-wide product strategy and influencing investment priorities at the executive level.
* Define the operating model for how Applied Intelligence is built, deployed, and continuously improved — including governance, evaluation standards, and responsible AI principles.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Product Development & AI Innovation**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Billtrust's AI-powered capabilities — from opportunity identification and experimentation through scaled delivery and ongoing iteration — leveraging co-worker agents and AI tooling to compress timelines and raise quality.
* Establish rigorous frameworks for evaluating AI product performance, accuracy, reliability, and customer safety before and after deployment.
* Drive a culture of bold experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and champion the learnings that most accelerate product-market fit.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to translate frontier AI capabilities into intuitive, production-grade customer experiences.

**Organization Building & Talent**

* Recruit, develop, and retain a high-caliber team of product managers and applied AI practitioners, building one of the most sought-after AI product organizations in B2B fintech.
* Champion AI-first ways of working across the entire Product organization, setting the standard for how leaders and ICs leverage AI tools to amplify impact.
* Create clear career pathways and a coaching culture that elevates team members into future leaders of AI product development.

**Market Presence & Commercial Impact**

* Serve as Billtrust's most senior external voice on Applied Intelligence — representing the company at industry events, in analyst conversations, and in strategic customer and partner engagements.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure AI differentiation is clearly communicated and consistently converted into pipeline and retention.
* Engage directly with key customers to co-create AI solutions, gather strategic insight, and validate roadmap direction against real-world complexity.

**What You'll Bring:**
**Required Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in product management, applied AI, or a related field, with significant tenure in executive or senior VP-level product leadership.
* Demonstrated experience setting AI strategy and driving AI-first transformation at scale across a product organization or business unit.
* Deep understanding of machine learning, large language models, agentic AI frameworks, and how these capabilities translate into production-grade B2B product experiences.
* Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing applied AI product teams in a fast-moving enterprise SaaS or fintech environment.
* Fluency in FinTech data: how financial data is structured, how it flows across ERP systems, payment networks, and AR workflows, and why data quality and latency matter differently in financial contexts than in general SaaS.
* Executive presence and communication skills that inspire confidence across the C-suite, board, customers, partners, and external audiences.
* Strong commercial acumen — able to connect AI product investment directly to revenue growth, retention, and competitive differentiation.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Direct experience in Order to Cash, accounts receivable, cash application, collections, or B2B payments — either building products in this space or operating within it at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with the data structures and integration patterns common in AR automation: ERP connectors, remittance data, invoice line-item detail, payment status feeds, and buyer identity resolution.
* Hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or multi-model orchestration in enterprise production environments.
* Track record of representing product vision externally — at conferences, in analyst briefings, or in strategic customer advisory settings.
* Experience co-creating AI solutions with enterprise customers and translating those partnerships into roadmap impact and revenue.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**We're looking for a**
****Director, Product Management****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Director, Product Management — Learning**
**About Cornerstone**
Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.
  
  
**About The Role**
Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.
  
  
You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.
  
  
**In this role you will...**
**Set vision & strategy**

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
* Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
* Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
* Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.

**Lead & grow the team**

* Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
* Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
* Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.

**Discover, experiment & measure**

* Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
* Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
* Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
* Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.

**Deliver with rigor**

* Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
* Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
* Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
* Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
* A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability. Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, anD measurable business outcomes.
* Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
* AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
* Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

* 10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.
* A track record of owning product vision and strategy for a product area and translating it into roadmaps that ship and drive outcomes.
* Demonstrated people leadership — hiring, coaching, and growing product managers and setting team standards.
* Strong discovery and experimentation skills: customer research, hypothesis-driven development, metrics definition, and A/B testing.
* Proven ability to lead execution across complex cross-functional organizations with operational rigor and release discipline.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, UX, data science, services, sales, support, and customer success, up to the executive level.
* Experience delivering products in secure, enterprise-grade environments where trust, reliability, and scalability matter, including familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in learning, HR technology, talent management, or skills/EdTech domains.
* Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.
* Experience with skills-based capabilities, content ecosystems, or analytics/insights products.
* Familiarity with regulated, security-conscious, or compliance-driven product environments and enterprise governance models for AI and data.

**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

**Location:**
Hyderabad (On-site)

**Experience:**
3–6 years

**About the Role**

We run high-intent, high-volume traffic across GrabOn's India, US, and UAE properties. We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition end-to-end — from search intent capture on Google/Bing, to paid social on Meta, to programmatic display and retargeting via DSPs. You'll be responsible for spend efficiency, incrementality, and revenue impact, not just clicks. This is a builder role for someone who treats a media budget like their own P&L.

What You'll Own

* Plan, launch, and scale
  **SEM campaigns**
  (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) across search, shopping, and Performance Max — structured for a coupon/deals business with thin margins and high keyword volume.
* Build and run
  **Meta (Facebook & Instagram) campaigns**
  — prospecting, retargeting, and dynamic product ads — with sharp audience strategy, creative testing, and full ownership of Meta Ads Manager and the Pixel/Conversions API.
* Build and manage
  **programmatic display and retargeting**
  through DSPs (DV360, The Trade Desk, or equivalent) — audience strategy, inventory, creative rotation, and frequency capping.
* Own the full funnel: keyword and audience research, bid strategy, budget pacing, landing page alignment, and conversion tracking.
* Set up and maintain
  **measurement infrastructure**
  — conversion tracking, GA4 events, GTM, Meta CAPI, and attribution — and defend every rupee/dollar of spend with data.
* Run structured
  **A/B tests**
  on creatives, bids, audiences, and landing pages; ship learnings, not just reports.
* Manage budgets across three geographies with distinct CPCs, currencies, and buyer behavior (India, US, GCC).
* Partner with SEO, content, and AI Labs to close the loop between paid and organic, and to automate reporting and optimization where possible.

**What You'll Need**

* 3–6 years running paid acquisition with real budget ownership and a track record of hitting ROAS/CPA targets at scale.
* Hands-on depth in
  **Google Ads**
  (Search, Shopping, PMax) — you can build a campaign structure from scratch and explain every bid decision.
* Proven experience running
  **Meta paid social**
  at scale — Ads Manager, audience/lookalike strategy, creative iteration, and Conversions API setup.
* Direct experience with at least one
  **DSP**
  (DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, or similar) — programmatic buying, audience building, and inventory management.
* Fluency in GA4, GTM, and conversion tracking; comfortable with UTM discipline and attribution debates.
* Strong Excel/Sheets modeling — you can build a spend-to-revenue model and spot a leaking campaign before the dashboard does.
* Analytical bias: you optimize toward incrementality and contribution margin, not vanity metrics.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in affiliate, coupons/deals, e-commerce, or high-volume performance environments.
* Familiarity with feed management, dynamic remarketing, or catalog/shopping feeds.
* Comfort using AI tools to automate reporting, bid adjustments, or creative iteration.
* Exposure to US/international markets beyond India.

title: Founding Growth Lead - B2B SaaS
description:
**Role: Founding Growth Lead - B2B SaaS**

**Company:**

StepsAI

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3 to 8 years (relevant experience matters more than years)

**Reports to:**
Founders

**About StepsAI**

StepsAI builds AI agents that help businesses sell more, generate leads, and handle customer support automatically.

Our AI agents work across websites, Shopify, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and voice calls. They help businesses answer customer questions, recommend products, recover abandoned carts, qualify leads, book appointments, and automate everyday customer interactions.

We're building for businesses in India and global markets.

We have a growing product, real customers, and a team that's constantly shipping new features.

**Now we're looking for someone who can help us build a repeatable inbound growth engine.**

**About the Role**

We're looking for a
**Founding Growth Lead**
who can take ownership of growing StepsAI's inbound acquisition from the ground up.

This is not a traditional marketing management role.

We want someone who understands how SaaS companies attract customers, convert website visitors into users, and turn product trials into paying customers.

You'll work directly with the founders to identify growth opportunities, experiment with acquisition channels, improve conversions, and build a scalable growth engine.

**Your goal is simple: Help more businesses discover StepsAI, try our product, and become paying customers.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Own Inbound Growth & Demand Generation

* Develop and execute our inbound growth strategy across India and international markets.
* Drive qualified traffic, product signups, demo requests, and paying customers.
* Identify the best acquisition channels and build repeatable growth processes.
* Run experiments, measure results, and scale what works.

2. SEO, AI Search & Organic Acquisition

* Build an SEO strategy targeting high-intent, business-focused searches.
* Identify keywords, competitor comparisons, and use cases that attract potential buyers.
* Improve StepsAI's visibility across Google and AI-powered search platforms.
* Work with the content team to create landing pages, comparison pages, guides, and customer stories that generate leads.

3. Product-Led Growth & Conversion Optimization

* Improve the journey from website visitor to signup, product activation, and paid subscription.
* Optimize landing pages, signup flows, onboarding, and conversion funnels.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to identify and remove friction.
* Run A/B tests and other experiments to improve acquisition and activation.

4. Shopify & Marketplace Growth

* Drive installations and adoption of our Shopify app.
* Improve App Store visibility, listing conversion, activation, and customer feedback.
* Explore other relevant marketplaces, directories, and integration ecosystems.
* Identify opportunities to acquire customers through the platforms they already use.

5. Performance Marketing & Growth Experiments

* Plan and execute targeted campaigns across Google Ads, Shopify App Store Ads, and other relevant channels.
* Test messaging, landing pages, keywords, and offers.
* Optimize acquisition costs and lead quality.
* Make data-backed decisions about which channels deserve more investment.

6. Partnerships & Distribution

* Explore partnerships with Shopify agencies, digital marketing agencies, consultants, and SaaS ecosystems.
* Develop repeatable referral and partner-led acquisition programs.
* Experiment with co-marketing, communities, and industry-specific distribution strategies.

7. Analytics & Growth Ownership

* Own the end-to-end acquisition and conversion funnel.
* Track qualified inbound leads, signups, activation, paid conversions, customer acquisition cost, and revenue.
* Set up and use tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, PostHog, Mixpanel, and CRM reporting.
* Share weekly growth insights, experiments, results, and next steps with the founders.

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in SaaS growth, demand generation, or growth marketing.
* Proven experience generating inbound leads, signups, or revenue for a B2B SaaS product.
* Strong understanding of SEO, performance marketing, landing-page optimization, and conversion funnels.
* Experience executing growth campaigns yourself, not just managing external agencies.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect marketing activities to business outcomes.
* Ability to independently plan, execute, measure, and iterate on growth experiments.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup with limited resources and high ownership.

**Good to Have**

* Experience growing a SaaS company from an early stage.
* Experience with product-led growth or self-serve SaaS products.
* Familiarity with Shopify, e-commerce SaaS, AI agents, or customer support platforms.
* Experience with international markets such as the US, UK, or Middle East.
* Experience building agency partnerships, referral programs, or marketplace acquisition channels.
* Familiarity with marketing automation and AI tools.

What Success Looks Like

**First 30 Days**

* Understand our customers, product, competitors, and acquisition funnel.
* Identify our most promising customer segments and inbound channels.
* Build a measurable growth plan and launch initial experiments.

**First 60 Days**

* Launch and optimize targeted acquisition campaigns.
* Improve website and signup conversion.
* Build a consistent process for generating qualified inbound opportunities.
* Identify early signals of repeatable acquisition.

**First 90 Days**

* Establish measurable inbound acquisition channels.
* Increase qualified signups, product activations, and inbound opportunities.
* Demonstrate which growth activities contribute to paying customers.
* Build a clear roadmap for scaling the most effective channels.

Why Join StepsAI?

* **Build from zero to one:**
  You'll create our growth engine rather than inherit an established process.
* **Real ownership:**
  Your work will directly influence customer acquisition and company revenue.
* **Work with founders:**
  Make decisions quickly and see your ideas implemented.
* **A product you can demonstrate:**
  Work with AI agents solving real sales and support problems.
* **Room to grow:**
  Opportunity to build and eventually lead the growth function as StepsAI scales.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building, experimenting, learning, and taking responsibility for outcomes.

How to Apply

Send your resume or LinkedIn profile along with brief answers to these questions:

1. **What's one SaaS product you've helped grow?**
   What was your specific contribution, and what measurable results did you achieve?
2. **Have you built an inbound acquisition channel from scratch?**
   Tell us what you did and what worked.
3. **If you joined StepsAI, what would you prioritize in your first 30 days?**

We care much more about what you've actually built and grown than impressive job titles.

title: City Head
description:
**City PnL Head – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving Business**

Own the city. Drive occupancy. Build systems. Deliver predictable growth.

**Why this role exists**

In coliving, a city is not just a geography.

It is a full business unit with its own demand, occupancy, cost structure, customer experience, and operational complexity.

At city level:

* Demand fluctuates continuously
* Supply is fragmented across multiple properties
* Resident expectations evolve constantly
* Execution gaps immediately affect occupancy and retention

Without strong city-level ownership, operations quickly become reactive.

The biggest failures usually happen when:

* Occupancy is managed week-to-week instead of structurally
* Sales and operations work independently instead of as one system
* Cost leakages go unnoticed

title: Director, Customer, Patient and Market Decision Intelligence
description:
**Summary**
The AIDE Opportunity, Performance and Measurement team enables I&A, Commercial, and Field organizations to improve decision-making through high-quality data, deep functional expertise, advanced analytics, and actionable insights that drive growth and performance across the portfolio. Working closely with the East Hanover COE and Decision Intelligence teams, the group brings analytical rigor and business insight to support smarter, data-driven decisions.
  
  
The Director, CPM DI will lead the Hyderabad-based integrated POD model across brands and therapeutic areas, delivering insights that answer two critical questions: how the business is performing and why, and which customers, patients, providers, physicians, and health plans should be engaged and how. This role requires strong healthcare customer understanding, the ability to integrate analytics into a clear business narrative, and close collaboration with AIDE capability and functional teams to deliver integrated commercial insights and recommendations.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Director, Customer , Patient and Market Decision Intelligence**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Major Accountabilities**

* Patient journey and pool prioritization: Lead creation of detailed patient journey mapping to identify key steps leading to diagnosis and treatment, leakage points and touchpoints, and lead patient pool prioritization at distinct points in the journey to drive growth.
* Patient, HCP, and provider segmentation: Assess unique features of patient and provider cohorts using secondary data (behavioral, attitudinal, clinical, level of access control and system complexity) and capabilities to inform personalized marketing and engagement strategies.
* Engagement drivers: Deliver insights on factors that influence prescribing patterns, roadblocks and drop-off points, and partner with internal stakeholders to refine engagement strategies.
* Influence mapping: Lead KOL identification through HCP influence, peer networks, reach and expertise assessment.
* Integrated narrative: Support the articulation of a clear narrative of the business performance and customer opportunity grounded in data and insights, considering current strategy and how it should evolve, in partnership with I&A Decision Intelligence team, as part of the I&A POD.
* Lead a team of experts in Hyderabad for the patient, provider and account analytics and drive hiring, onboarding, and coaching team members to build a collaborative, high-performing culture.
* Lead efforts to upskill, mentor, and support the professional growth of the team members, ensuring their sustained development and alignment with organizational goals.
* Data pipeline quality: Maintain close connection with Data Ops, Functional Excellence and Reporting to optimize the data-to-analysis-to-reporting pipeline and investigate performance anomalies with End-to-End Quality Assurance so that data variance is not interpreted as performance signal.
* Own cross-portfolio analytics and requests accountability in CPM, focused on patients, providers, HCPs and market dynamics insights, pulling in the TA subject matter expertise and capacity from respective teams.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 12 years of experience in pharma or healthcare industry, with a strong understanding of market dynamics, regulatory environments and healthcare providers and patient behaviors.
* Proven track record in customer analytics and performance management, strategic planning or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to drive business outcomes through data-driven insights.
* 8+ years of domain expertise in one or more of: enterprise analytics, secondary data analytics, primary market research, field analytics, patient service analytics, or related strategic analytics/management consulting.
* 7+ years of people management experience, with a proven track record of enabling data-driven decision-making at a senior leadership level, including addressing complex business challenges and shaping organizational strategy in therapeutic areas
* Experience creating and implementing segmentation models for HCPs and patients based on attitudes, behaviors, and beliefs.
* Experience creating end-to-end patient and provider journey maps and managing multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals
* Experience managing relationships with key stakeholders, including senior leadership and external partners
* Substantial people leadership experience, including leading senior talent, developing leaders, and operating through globally distributed or cross-location delivery models.
* Proven ability to lead multiple complex priorities, establish governance and decision rights, and deliver high-quality outcomes under ambiguity and tight timelines.

**Leadership Skills**

* Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team through Associate Director and SM leaders, creating clear accountability for enterprise value, business impact, functional expertise, and quality of delivery.
* Able to navigate cross-functional complexities and enable impactful and fast decision-making by identifying core issues of the situations, keeping focused on the big picture, and adapting and prioritizing during the change
* Collaborate across boundaries, influence without authority, integrate diverse perspectives, challenge assumptions with data-driven decision making, and adapt leadership style to maximize team and enterprise impact.
* Own talent planning for the capability, including hiring, onboarding, objective setting, coaching, performance management, succession, career development, engagement, and retention.
* Build strategic consulting and executive advisory capability of the team so that analytical outputs consistently translate into actionable business recommendations.
* Create a culture of collaboration, constructive challenge, innovation, inclusion, continuous improvement, and accountability across Hyderabad and cross-functional teams.
* Support I&A and AIDE leadership on cross-team talent priorities, organizational operations, capability planning, and site-level initiatives.

**Success Measurements**

* Decision Impact: Enterprise recommendations materially improve the quality, speed, and clarity of portfolio, forecasting, and investment decisions.
* Segmentation effectiveness: Accuracy and actionability of patient and provider segments created from behavioral, attitudinal and clinical data.
* Journey mapping completeness: Feedback rating on comprehensiveness and insight quality of patient and provider journey maps, including leakage points and touchpoints.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Effectiveness of collaboration and integration of insights across teams, and clarity of communication between functional and business teams.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Strong endorsement from the US Enterprise team, I&A LT, AIDE leader and underlying functional leaders on influence, responsiveness, and quality of challenge.
* Talent & Team Health: Successful hiring, development, engagement, retention, and progression of senior talent, with clear succession and capability plans.

**Required Skills**

* Exceptional business acumen paired with a deep understanding of pharmaceutical business dynamics
* Deep understanding of patient and provider data as well as behavioural, attitudinal and clinical data within a healthcare network
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex insights and solutions persuasively to diverse audiences
* Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including marketing, market research, field insights, NPS insights, performance insights and patient engagement, to drive strategic alignment
* Strong leadership skills in a team environment requiring negotiation, persuasion, collaboration, and analytical judgment
* Commitment to driving and enabling data-driven decision making throughout all levels of the organization
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing business needs and priorities

**Preferred Skills**

* Deep understanding of the US pharmaceutical commercial model, portfolio economics, and associated data and analytics ecosystem.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical datasets such as prescription, claims, patient-level, access, promotional, finance, and operational data.
* Strong program management, change management, and senior stakeholder communication capability.

**Location:**
Hyderabad NKC | Hybrid | 3 days a week in office is mandatory.

5-8 Associate Director and Senior Manager level leaders

title: Email Marketing Strategist
description:
Job Description: Email Outbound Strategist

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor (IC)

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced
**Email Outbound Strategist**
to own and scale B2B outbound email campaigns, generate qualified leads, and build a predictable sales pipeline. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in cold email outreach, email deliverability, audience segmentation, marketing automation, and outbound campaign optimization.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute B2B outbound email strategies to generate qualified leads, meetings, and sales pipeline.
* Identify target accounts and decision-makers through audience segmentation, list building, and data enrichment.
* Create compelling cold email copy and multi-step outreach sequences tailored to different buyer personas.
* Manage outbound email infrastructure, including domains, inboxes, sending volumes, and sender reputation.
* Monitor and troubleshoot email deliverability issues, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce rates, and spam complaints.
* Manage outbound campaigns using HubSpot and tools such as Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, or Outreach.
* Conduct A/B testing to improve email engagement, reply rates, meeting bookings, and conversion.
* Track and report weekly performance metrics, including emails sent, replies, meetings booked, SQLs, and pipeline generated.
* Collaborate with sales teams to ensure effective lead handoff and continuous improvement of outbound performance.

Mandatory Skills

* 5–8 years of experience in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or outbound email marketing.
* Proven experience independently managing end-to-end cold email campaigns.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including workflows, lists, custom properties, and reporting.
* Experience with outbound tools such as Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, Outreach, or similar platforms.
* Strong knowledge of email deliverability, domain warming, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and sender reputation management.
* Experience with lead enrichment and prospecting tools such as Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Excellent B2B email copywriting, segmentation, and campaign optimization skills.
* Proven ability to generate qualified meetings, SQLs, and measurable sales pipeline through outbound campaigns.

Good to Have

* Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and multi-channel outreach.
* Experience targeting senior B2B decision-makers.
* Agency experience or experience managing multiple ICPs and campaigns.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and optimize performance.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on outbound specialist who can independently manage the complete process—from identifying prospects and writing email sequences to maintaining deliverability, optimizing campaigns, and generating measurable sales pipeline.

**Note:**
Candidates with only B2C email marketing, newsletter management, or general digital marketing experience without hands-on B2B cold outbound and deliverability expertise will not be suitable.

title: B2B Branding & Marketing Lead (EXP: 8 Yrs to 12 Yrs)
description:
**Job Description: B2B Branding & Marketing Lead (EXP: 8 Yrs to 12 Yrs)**
**About Bilvantis**
Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Our work is strong, but not enough people know about it yet. This role changes that. You'll build Bilvantis into a recognised Data & AI Solutions brand and a visible Databricks and Google Cloud partner, so that marketing brings in real leads. You'll also make Bilvantis known as a place where people grow, so that strong talent in India wants to join us.
  
  
**What you'll own::**
**Brand Strategy And Positioning**

* Get to know Bilvantis deeply, including our capabilities, values, solutions, accelerators and partnerships, and turn that into a clear brand story and messaging framework.
* Define the brand and marketing strategy, then carry it out with discipline: plans, calendars, owners and deadlines.
* Keep the brand consistent everywhere it appears, from the website and decks to social media, events and recruiting.

**Demand Generation And Inbound Pipeline**

* Build programmes that bring in inbound leads and opportunities from our target industries (BFSI and Manufacturing) and regions (US, India, UAE, UK).
* Run campaigns built on content, account-based marketing (ABM), webinars and email.
* Work closely with sales and account teams so that marketing leads turn into real conversations, and track what converts.

**Partner Marketing (Databricks And Google Cloud)**

* Make Bilvantis visible across the Databricks and Google Cloud ecosystems through co-marketing, joint case studies, partner events and listings.
* Use partner marketing programmes and funds well, and support our goals for moving up partner tiers and winning awards.

**LinkedIn And Digital Channels**

* Own the company's LinkedIn presence: strategy, content, cadence and growth among senior leaders in Data & AI, BFSI and Manufacturing.
* Build leadership thought leadership, including executive profiles, articles and point-of-view content.
* Run employee advocacy so our people amplify the brand.
* Own the website, SEO and other digital channels so that Bilvantis is easy to find and credible when people land on us.

**Content And Thought Leadership**

* Produce case studies, solution briefs, blogs, whitepapers, videos and the quarterly newsletter.
* Create sales enablement material, such as decks, one-pagers and proposal content, that the field actually uses.

**Employer Brand And Culture (India Focus)**

* Show Bilvantis as a company that builds talent and grows its people, through employee stories, culture content, campus and community programmes, and the careers page.
* Work with HR and Talent Acquisition to make Bilvantis a destination for Data & AI, Mainframe and VisionPlus talent in India.

**Events, PR And Recognition**

* Plan and run events, meetups and conference appearances, both our own and with partners.
* Drive media coverage, award entries and analyst visibility.

**Budget, Tools And Measurement**

* Own the marketing budget, agencies and freelancers, and the marketing tools (CRM, automation, analytics).
* Report results to leadership every month and every quarter, and shift spend to what works.

**What You Bring**

* Prior Experience: 8+ years to 12 years in B2B Branding and Marketing, ideally in IT Services or Technology organization.
* Branding and marketing depth: a proven record of building a B2B brand, not just running activities.
* Strategy with execution: you can set the direction and then deliver it carefully, detail by detail.
* LinkedIn and digital expertise: strong, hands-on command of LinkedIn and the other channels that matter in B2B tech.
* Communication: excellent writing and storytelling, and the ability to make technical topics land with business leaders.
* Focus on results: you measure success in leads, pipeline and reach, not in volume of activity.
* Understanding of technology: comfortable enough with Data, AI and cloud to tell our story credibly, and to work with our architects to get it right.
* Teamwork: you work well with sales, delivery, practice and HR teams, and with partner marketing teams at Databricks and Google Cloud.
* Ownership: you're comfortable being the first and lead marketing hire, building the function yourself and taking it from there.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with Databricks, Google Cloud or hyperscaler partner marketing.
* Background in IT services or Data & AI marketing.
* Experience marketing to US, UK or Middle East audiences from India.
* Hands-on with marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Canva/Figma, LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Analytics.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Inbound leads and pipeline generated by marketing, and how many convert into opportunities.
* Growth in LinkedIn followers, engagement and reach among the target audiences.
* Visibility in the Databricks and Google Cloud ecosystems, including co-marketing activity, partner-sourced leads, and awards or recognition.
* Employer brand results: more inbound applicants, better candidate quality, and stronger offer acceptance in India.
* Content and campaigns delivered on plan.
* Marketing ROI and budget discipline.

**Why Join**

* Build the Bilvantis brand from the ground up, with real ownership and visibility.
* Work directly with leadership on a company that's growing fast.
* A strong story to tell: real solutions, accelerators and partner momentum.

Purple Business is an AI-powered business growth platform designed to help restaurants, cafes, local businesses, and small and medium enterprises grow through better marketing, branding, customer experiences, and AI-powered business solutions.

We believe that every business, regardless of its size, deserves access to powerful tools, strategies, and insights that can help it grow.

We're looking for a
**highly creative, camera-confident, and social media-savvy Content Creator**
who can help establish Purple Business's online presence, create engaging content, and build a growing community of business owners, entrepreneurs, and marketing enthusiasts.

This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder, experiment with creative ideas, and help build the social media identity of an AI startup from its earliest stages.

  **small business growth, marketing strategies, branding, advertising, customer acquisition, entrepreneurship, AI tools, and business success stories**

* Experiment with storytelling techniques, hooks, trends, humor, and creative formats to maximize viewer engagement.

  .

* Create engaging captions, headlines, hooks, descriptions, and calls to action.

* Experiment with different content types to improve reach, engagement, follower growth, and brand awareness.
* Monitor performance metrics such as views, watch time, retention, engagement rate, profile visits, follower growth, and inbound inquiries.

3. Community Engagement & Brand Building

* Actively engage with relevant content posted by entrepreneurs, restaurant owners, small businesses, creators, and marketing communities.
* Respond thoughtfully to comments, messages, mentions, and audience questions across Purple Business's social media accounts.
* Participate in relevant online discussions to increase brand visibility and establish meaningful connections.
* Build relationships with business owners, founders, content creators, and potential customers.
* Help create an engaged community around business growth, entrepreneurship, marketing, and AI.
* Identify opportunities to turn social media engagement into meaningful conversations and potential business leads.

4. Collaborations & Partnerships

* Identify and reach out to
  **small businesses, restaurants, cafes, entrepreneurs, influencers, and content creators**
  for potential collaborations.
* Develop creative collaboration concepts such as joint reels, business interviews, success stories, educational videos, and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate collaborative content initiatives with business owners and other creators.
* Explore cross-promotion opportunities, co-created content, and community partnerships to increase organic reach.
* Build relationships with relevant micro-influencers and niche creators in the entrepreneurship, marketing, and small business ecosystem.

5. Creative Design & Content Production

* Collaborate closely with Purple Business's
  **visual designers and motion designers**
  to produce high-quality social media creatives.
* Contribute ideas for Instagram carousels, graphics, thumbnails, video covers, advertisements, and promotional content.
* Maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity across the brand's social media channels.
* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other AI-powered content creation tools for brainstorming, scripting, visual ideation, and content production.
* Independently handle basic video editing, captions, transitions, audio, and other creative elements.

**Bonus:**
Candidates with strong visual design skills, Figma proficiency, graphic design expertise, or motion design capabilities will be highly preferred.

6. Founder Collaboration & Content Strategy

* **Work directly with the founder of Purple Business**
  to brainstorm content ideas, develop creative strategies, and establish the brand's social media direction.
* Translate the founder's ideas, product vision, and business insights into compelling and accessible social media content.
* Participate in content brainstorming sessions, creative reviews, and growth strategy discussions.
* Research successful content formats, competitor strategies, and emerging opportunities.
* Develop innovative ideas to position Purple Business as a valuable resource for small business owners.
* Experiment with different messaging, content styles, and audience segments to discover what resonates.
* Take ownership of creative initiatives and contribute to the company's long-term brand-building strategy.

Requirements

* **Excellent on-camera confidence and communication skills**
  , with the ability to present ideas naturally, clearly, and engagingly.
* **Strong understanding of Instagram**
  , particularly Reels, content trends, engagement strategies, and organic audience growth.
* Proven ability to create visually appealing, high-quality, and engaging short-form video content.
* Good understanding of storytelling, video hooks, pacing, audience retention, and content structure.
* Experience using video editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools.
* Strong creativity and the ability to consistently come up with original content ideas.
* Good written communication skills for captions, scripts, social media posts, and community interactions.
* Understanding of social media growth strategies, audience engagement, and content performance analytics.
* Comfortable reaching out to businesses, creators, and potential collaborators to explore partnerships.
* Ability to independently manage content creation from ideation to final publishing.
* Interest in
  **marketing, entrepreneurship, small businesses, AI, and startup growth**
  .
* Ability to work collaboratively with visual designers, motion designers, and the founding team.
* A proactive attitude, attention to detail, and willingness to experiment, learn, and improve.

Preferred Skills

About Purple Business

Purple Business is an AI-powered business growth platform being built to help restaurants, cafes, local businesses, and small and medium enterprises grow smarter and faster.

Our vision is to make powerful marketing, customer acquisition, business intelligence, branding, and growth strategies accessible to every business through AI.

We are currently in the
**pre-product launch stage**
, building our platform while actively exploring the market, understanding customer needs, establishing relationships with businesses, and developing our go-to-market strategy.

We are looking for
**ambitious, proactive, and entrepreneurial Sales & Marketing Interns**
who want to gain hands-on experience in building the sales and growth engine of an AI startup from the ground up.

This is not a conventional internship where you simply execute assigned marketing tasks. You'll have the opportunity to experiment with sales strategies, engage with real businesses, understand market challenges, and contribute directly to how Purple Business acquires its first customers.

Key Responsibilities1. Outbound Sales & Business Development

* Identify and research potential customers, particularly restaurants, cafes, retail stores, service providers, and other small businesses.
* Conduct consistent outbound prospecting through
  **cold emails, LinkedIn outreach, phone calls, Instagram DMs, and other appropriate channels**
  .
* Build and maintain a pipeline of potential customers interested in Purple Business.
* Connect with business owners, founders, managers, and decision-makers to understand their marketing and growth challenges.
* Develop personalized outreach messages, cold-email sequences, follow-ups, and sales pitches.
* Schedule discovery calls, product demonstrations, and introductory meetings with potential customers.
* Follow up systematically with prospects and work toward converting qualified opportunities into pilot customers and paying customers when the product is ready.

2. Sales Strategy & Sales Cycle Development

* Understand and help develop the complete
  **B2B sales cycle**
  , including prospecting, lead qualification, discovery, pitching, objection handling, negotiation, closing, and follow-up.
* Experiment with different outreach approaches, sales scripts, value propositions, and customer segments.
* Develop compelling sales pitches tailored to different types of businesses and their specific challenges.
* Identify common customer objections and develop strategies to address them.
* Help establish repeatable sales processes, lead qualification frameworks, CRM workflows, and follow-up systems.
* Monitor important sales metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, qualified leads, booked meetings, conversion rates, and pipeline progress.

3. Inbound Marketing & Social Media Growth

* Contribute to Purple Business's inbound marketing strategy to attract potential customers organically.
* Develop and execute social media growth strategies across
  **Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms**
  .
* Brainstorm content ideas, campaigns, reels, carousels, and business-focused educational content.
* Identify opportunities to generate inbound leads through content marketing, communities, referrals, partnerships, and organic discovery.
* Collaborate with visual design and motion design teams to develop engaging marketing creatives and advertisements.
* Explore SEO, lead magnets, landing pages, and other inbound lead generation strategies.

4. Product Understanding & Market Research

* Develop a strong understanding of Purple Business, its vision, capabilities, target customers, and competitive advantages.
* Research how restaurants and small businesses currently handle marketing, customer acquisition, branding, advertising, and business growth.
* Identify customer pain points, unmet needs, and opportunities that Purple Business could address.
* Gather feedback directly from business owners and share actionable insights with the founding and product teams.
* Analyze competitors, market trends, pricing models, and emerging AI-powered business solutions.
* Help validate product positioning, pricing assumptions, and potential use cases before launch.

5. Pre-Launch Growth & Go-to-Market Execution

* Help Purple Business build its initial customer pipeline before the product officially launches.
* Identify early adopters willing to participate in discovery interviews, product feedback sessions, and pilot programs.
* Experiment with different positioning statements, customer acquisition channels, and go-to-market approaches.
* Assist in developing the company's initial marketing and sales playbook.
* Create strategies to convert early interest into product trials, pilot partnerships, and paying customers once commercially available.
* Work directly with the founding team to identify what works, improve unsuccessful approaches, and continuously refine the growth strategy.

Requirements

* **Strong communication and interpersonal skills**
  , with confidence in approaching business owners and decision-makers.
* Genuine interest in
  **sales, marketing, entrepreneurship, business development, and startup growth**
  .
* Comfortable with cold outreach, prospecting, follow-ups, and initiating conversations with unfamiliar people.
* Understanding of basic sales concepts such as lead generation, sales funnels, qualification, conversion, and customer acquisition.
* Interest in both
  **outbound sales and inbound marketing strategies**
  .
* Familiarity with social media platforms, digital marketing trends, and content-driven growth.
* Ability to understand a product, identify its value proposition, and explain it convincingly to potential customers.
* Willingness to research industries, analyze competitors, and experiment with different customer acquisition approaches.
* Ability to track leads, manage outreach records, and organize follow-ups using spreadsheets or CRM tools.
* A proactive, independent, and results-oriented approach to work.
* Comfortable working in an early-stage startup environment where strategies, product offerings, and priorities may evolve.

**Previous sales experience is not mandatory.**
We value initiative, curiosity, communication ability, and willingness to learn more than academic qualifications.

Who We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in candidates who:

* Enjoy talking to people, building relationships, and persuading others through genuine value.
* Are not afraid of cold calling, cold emailing, or handling rejection.
* Can independently find business opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.
* Think creatively about how to attract, engage, and convert potential customers.
* Are curious about why businesses succeed, why customers buy, and how sales strategies work.
* Have an experimental mindset and are comfortable testing different sales and marketing approaches.
* Want to understand how a startup acquires its first 10, 100, and eventually 1,000 customers.
* Are enthusiastic about AI, business growth, marketing, and entrepreneurship.
* Want to work closely with startup founders and contribute meaningfully during the earliest stages of building a company.

Compensation & Performance-Based Incentives

This internship
**does not currently offer a fixed stipend or guaranteed earnings**
.

Instead, Purple Business intends to offer performance-based financial incentives linked to successful business development and customer acquisition outcomes.

Depending on the agreed incentive plan, eligible achievements may include:

* Successfully acquiring new paying customers.
* Converting qualified business prospects into confirmed commercial deals.
* Securing eligible paid pilot engagements or partnerships.
* Achieving predefined sales and customer acquisition milestones.

The incentive structure, qualifying conditions, payment timelines, and eligibility requirements will be communicated in writing before commencement.

As Purple Business is currently in its pre-launch stage, commercial conversion opportunities may initially be limited. No minimum earnings or guaranteed conversion opportunities are promised.

Any arrangement will be subject to applicable internship, employment, and compensation laws.

What You'll Gain

* **Direct Founder Collaboration:**
  Work closely with the Purple Business founding team on real sales, marketing, product positioning, and business growth challenges.
* **Real-World Sales Experience:**
  Learn how to approach customers, conduct discovery calls, handle objections, build pipelines, and develop sales strategies.
* **Startup Building Experience:**
  Experience the journey of taking an AI product from its pre-launch stage to its first customers.
* **Marketing & GTM Exposure:**
  Gain practical knowledge of outbound prospecting, inbound marketing, customer acquisition, positioning, and go-to-market execution.
* **AI & Business Knowledge:**
  Understand how AI-powered solutions can help businesses improve their marketing and growth.
* **Performance-Based Earning Opportunities:**
  Become eligible for incentives based on the agreed structure and qualifying outcomes.
* **Professional Portfolio:**
  Build documented experience in customer research, campaign execution, lead generation, and sales performance.
* **Mentorship & Career Development:**
  Receive feedback on communication, sales strategy, marketing, business thinking, and professional development.

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
**The Role :**

At Recykal, strategy is not a support function. It is a growth engine. As part of the Strategy team, you will work alongside business leaders to shape high impact decisions that influence growth, profitability and long term market positioning. You will be embedded within a business unit cluster, working as a strategic partner who turns ambiguity into action.

**CORE MANDATE:**

* Own annual strategic planning for the assigned business unit cluster — market sizing, competitive landscaping, and opportunity assessment.
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Lead strategic projects spanning product launches, pricing strategy, and market expansion.
* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership, aligning priorities across teams.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health and build dashboards that surface the right signals.
* Prepare executive presentations and board-level materials that drive decision-making at the top.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* 4–8 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or business development
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities; comfortable building models from scratch
* Experience solving complex, end-to-end strategic business problems with measurable impact
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for modelling, analysis, and executive storytelling
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
* MBA / equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; strong academic foundation in business or economics

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**A. BU STRATEGY & ANNUAL PLANNING**

* Own annual strategic planning; conduct market sizing, competitive landscaping and opportunity assessments
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with milestones and success metrics
* Work with BU heads to define strategic priorities for the year ahead
* Monitor strategy execution, track KPIs, and flag early-warning signals

**B. COMMERCIAL & GROWTH INITIATIVES**

* Lead strategic projects — product launches, pricing strategy, market expansion
* Build robust financial models and business cases for new opportunities
* Identify white spaces and adjacencies for growth
* Partner with Sales, Product and Operations to convert strategy into measurable outcomes

**C. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership
* Collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations on cross-functional initiatives
* Influence decision-making without direct authority
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels

**D. PERFORMANCE & INSIGHTS**

* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health; build dashboards for leadership
* Develop competitive intelligence frameworks to track market dynamics and benchmark Recykal's position

**E. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING**

* Prepare crisp, well-structured executive presentations and board-level materials
* Synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
* Communicate decisions and strategic context in a way that builds confidence and clarity

**WHY THIS ROLE?**

* Embedded strategic partner shaping high-impact decisions for a business unit cluster
* Direct exposure to BU heads, central leadership, and investors
* Own strategy end to end — from market sizing to boardroom storytelling
* Equal parts analyst and communicator — build the models and deliver the narrative

description:
**Role: Brand and Content Manager**

**Business:**
Digital Health Joint Venture (Biological E Initiative)

**Reporting to:**
Chief Marketing Officer

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Role Purpose**

Shape how India discovers and engages with health and wellness by creating the online voice, identity, and narrative for the venture and building a content presence for both online and offline channels. This is a ground-up role: own every digital channel end to end, build a content engine that speaks authentically across India's many languages, regions and communities, powered by data, sharpened by AI, and brought to life through smart, resourceful partnerships with creators and influencers.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Create and own the online voice, identity, and narrative for the venture — the tone, story, and personality that come through consistently across every digital touchpoint.
* Define and own the content strategy across both online and offline channels, grounded in performance data, keyword/search intelligence, and audience insight, with dashboards and reporting to track performance and iterate fast.
* Lead the creation of content that connects with different consumer segments across health topics, and is sensitive to regional and cultural nuances across India.
* Lead ideation, scripting, and production of content across formats (video, social, blog, web) that translates the brand's positioning into content people actually engage with.
* Manage the content calendar and publishing cadence across platforms, ensuring consistency of voice, timing, and quality.
* Manage all digital channels end-to-end — website, social media, and other online platforms — ensuring they work together as one coherent brand presence.
* Use AI tools for research, drafting, editing, repurposing, and analytics as a core part of the daily workflow to increase output quality and speed.

* Work closely with clinical advisors, subject matter experts, and doctors to translate health and clinical information into content that's accurate, accessible, and easy for a lay audience to understand.
* Work closely with the CMO, brand, and GTM teams to ensure content supports broader go-to-market and category-building goals.

**Experience**

* 3-5 years of experience, with meaningful time in an agency, D2C/consumer brand, or high-growth startup environment.

* Hands-on experience creating and directing content across formats including ability to write, brief, and edit.
* Experience working directly with influencers/creators involving sourcing, negotiating, briefing, and managing them.
* Experience in building brand voice, identity, or narrative for a consumer-facing product or platform.
* Comfortable working closely with clinical advisors, subject matter experts, and doctors to shape accurate, consumer-friendly health content. No clinical background required.

* Strong written and verbal communication, and everyday fluency with AI tools for content workflows (e.g., generative AI for drafting/ideation, AI-assisted editing, research tools).

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (TMT- AI Data Centers, Semiconductors, and Tech Hardware Research)**
Deloitte’s Center for TMT is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (R&I) group, focusing primarily on the TMT industry. The Center's goals are to:
  
  

* Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the TMT industry
* Provide practical and actionable insights - whether they are strategic, technical, operational.
* Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the health and evolution of the TMT industry.
* Make extensive use of leading practices from TMT professionals across diverse disciplines, including content strategy, digital distribution, advertising and monetization, consumer analytics, rights management, finance, risk management, regulation, and human capital, to identify innovative steps they have taken to address critical challenges.

Learn more about the TMT Center and have a peek into our work here .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the Technology sector with particular focus primarily on semiconductor and enterprise hardware sub-sectors (including AI data center infrastructure), as well as consumer tech (secondary focus).
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in Technology sector, with a focus on AI tech infrastructure (e.g., data centers, memory, GPUs, networking, edge, etc.), hybrid computing architectures, advanced packaging of hardware and chips, AI in chip design and manufacturing, strategic supply chain chokepoints, and adoption of AI/agent powered consumer devices and edge applications. These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist Assistant Manager, focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse Tech sector (with a focus on semiconductor and enterprise hardware) topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Develop and maintain subsector-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan. Execute structured research plans by translating business objectives into clear research questions, identifying areas of investigation, and conducting thorough secondary research using relevant and trustworthy industry, company, and news sources.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals – through a combination of expertise and direct study, complemented by AI tools.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Being largely autonomous (with minimal supervision) and managing the projects to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines, demonstrating a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Ability to apply sound research judgment by grounding outputs in direct study and critical thinking, while using generative AI tools to enhance efficiency (and not as a substitute for independent synthesis.)
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings

**Requisite Experience And Skills**
**Experience**

* 6-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects, preferably in Technology industry related topics and areas as noted earlier in this document.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

**Industry/sector/subsector skills**

* Business research/thought-leadership development in Technology sector is preferred. Knowledge of AI [1] driven chip demand, AI chips and accelerators that support data centers, role of AI in chip design and manufacturing, chip hardware and integrated systems’ time-to-market, and fab efficiency.
* Familiarity with architectural innovation, heterogeneous compute. (CPU/GPU/NPU/memory/interconnects), chiplet-based designs, co-packaged optics, advanced chip packaging and their role in performance and cost curves.
* Awareness about strategic chokepoints and importance of supply chain resilience for hardware and semiconductor components; Geopolitical and operational risks in this space.
* Consumer and end-user needs and attitudes towards AI and agent-powered devices and applications for work, education, and personal reasons – including AI at the edge.

**Technical skills**

title: Social Media Operations
description:
**We’re Hiring: Social Media Publishing Intern**

EkamDor is looking for college students who are interested in social media, online communities, and emerging digital platforms to join our team as Social Media Publishing Interns.

Location: Remote

Duration: 3-6 Months

Eligibility: College Students / Freshers Only

**About the Internship**

This is a 3-6 months, execution-focused internship designed for college students who want practical experience working with social media publishing and content operations.

You will not be expected to develop social media strategies, design graphics, or create content from scratch. Our content, captions, creatives, and publishing instructions will generally be provided.

Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that approved content is published accurately and on time across our social media platforms.

Based on your performance, reliability, and contribution during the 3-6 month internship, selected interns may have the opportunity to continue with EkamDor on a paid basis.

Please note that paid continuation is performance-based and is not guaranteed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Publish and schedule pre-approved posts, images, videos, captions, and other content.
* Follow the content calendar and publishing schedule.
* Check captions, hashtags, mentions, links, tags, and other publishing details.
* Ensure content is published in the correct format for each platform.
* Maintain a simple content calendar or publishing log.
* Monitor scheduled posts and report publishing errors or platform issues.
* Follow established publishing workflows and instructions consistently.
* Coordinate with the team to ensure content goes live correctly and on time.

**Platforms**

Instagram | Facebook | LinkedIn | YouTube | X | Reddit | Bluesky

Familiarity with X, Reddit, and Bluesky is particularly valuable for this role.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing a college degree or diploma.
* Open to freshers with no prior professional experience.
* Active and comfortable using social media platforms.
* Good understanding of how different social media platforms work.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to follow instructions accurately.
* Good organizational and time-management skills.
* Good written communication and basic English proficiency.
* Reliable, punctual, and responsive.
* Comfortable using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
* Access to a reliable laptop and internet connection.
* Able to commit to the full 3-6 month internship.

**Good to Have**

* Active participation on X, Reddit, or Bluesky beyond basic browsing.
* Experience managing a personal, college, community, or student social media account.
* Experience with Meta Business Suite or other scheduling tools.
* Familiarity with writing short-form posts or threads.
* Basic understanding of social media analytics.
* Interest in internet culture, online communities, and emerging social platforms.

**Who We’re Looking For**

We’re looking for college students who are curious, reliable, organized, and genuinely comfortable being on the internet.

You don't need to be a social media expert, strategist, designer, or content creator.

What matters is that you understand how social platforms work, pay attention to details, follow instructions accurately, and can be trusted to make sure content goes out correctly and on time.

Interns who demonstrate strong performance, consistency, ownership, and reliability during this period may be considered for a paid opportunity with EkamDor.

Paid continuation will be based on individual performance and the company's requirements at the end of the internship.

**How to Apply**

If you are a college student looking for a practical social media internship, we’d love to hear from you.

If you have previously managed a personal, college, community, or student social media account, feel free to include relevant links or examples with your application.

Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply.

Apply through the EkamDor LinkedIn job posting.

You can also send your resume to : qaekamdor@gmail.com
